name: Fisher Reference
description: Fisher K-10 Dynamic Spacexpander IR, convolution only, natural decay. Third-party IR (Freesound 528139); its arrival times (within 6%) and spectrum (within ~2 dB below 4 kHz) match the K-10 service manual, but it was not captured by this project.

name: Vintage Splash
description: Bright parallel hybrid: real-tank body with model boing and splash on hits. Guitar-amp style drip.

name: Deep Dub Spring
description: Long, warm send spring with gentle regeneration. The default rimshot/snare send.

name: Metallic Resonance
description: Model-led, high resonance and dispersion: singing metallic mode, tuned by Tension.

name: Heavy Pressure
description: Hard-driven tank with saturated feedback - thick, compressed, distorted dub wall.

name: Dark Chamber
description: Dark, smooth tank - spring as a small room. Low splash, low movement.

name: Infinite Dub
description: Feedback at max with some self-oscillation: holds and builds. Ride Feedback/Self-Osc live; guard is partly off.

name: Broken Spring
description: Max movement and boing: jolts, pitch lurches and clatter, like a tank on a shaking amp.

name: Short Percussion Spring
description: Short, tight, bright tank for hats, shakers and percussion loops. Keeps transients.

name: Experimental Mechanical
description: Model > IR with saturated feedback and slow modulation: grinding, mechanical drones from chords and pads.
